Subject: Need help with a land dispute case

Hello, my name is Charulata Gill. I am a 63-year-old mechanical engineer living in Ahmedabad. I have a land dispute with Nikhil Tiwari over land worth INR 3,86,00,000/-, and the neighbour has encroached on the boundary of the plot. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 68589 48191 or email charulata.gill@example.in.
